Guard the prayers, especially the middle prayer; in fear pray on foot or riding, and when secure remember Allah as He taught you.
Believers must not approach prayer intoxicated or in janabah until washed; if ill, traveling or without water after relieving or contact with women, they wipe with clean earth.
Prayer may be shortened when traveling in fear; in danger it is prayed in groups carrying arms, and once secure the regular prayer at its specified times is re-established.
Establish prayer at both ends of the day and as night approaches; good deeds remove misdeeds; be patient, for Allah never lets the reward of doers of good be lost.
Establish prayer from the sun's decline to the night's darkness and the dawn recitation, and pray extra at night, hoping your Lord raises you to a praised station.
Enjoin prayer on your family and be steadfast in it; Allah asks no provision of you but provides for you, and the best outcome is for righteousness.
Recite the revealed Book and establish prayer, for prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater.
Exalt Allah in the evening and morning, at night and at noon, the times of the daily prayers; all praise in the heavens and earth is His.
The one wrapped in garments is told to stand in prayer much of the night, recite the Quran slowly, remember his Lord's name and take Him as Disposer of affairs.
Allah knows the Prophet and others stand much of the night; He turned to them in forgiveness, so recite what is easy, pray, give zakah, lend Allah a goodly loan.
Abu Jahl, who forbids a servant from praying and turns away, will be dragged by his lying forelock unless he stops; do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near.
Woe to those who pray but are heedless of their prayer, who make a show of their deeds and withhold simple help.
